destination.title: Charged Nariai geometry, emission and cosmological evolution
destination.question: How are charged Nariai backgrounds constructed and characterized, what quantum processes occur on them, and under which assumptions can those processes constrain their evolution or cosmological interpretation?
destination.summary: A proposed broad family spanning ordinary geometry, quantum fields, gravitational dynamics and inflationary instantons, with explicit neighboring homes for other charged-black-hole consistency questions. This revised organization remains a proposal requiring independent review.

evidence.text: How does scalar charge emission behave when the event and cosmological horizons of charged Nariai black holes approach coincidence, and what might the discharge imply for cosmic censorship?

sources.title: Charged Nariai black holes on the dark bubble

evidence.text: Can a charged Nariai black hole be realized on the dark bubble, and can its interpretation as a thick string reproduce the electromagnetic coupling relation previously obtained for a microscopic charged black hole?

sources.title: Charged Nariai black holes with a dilaton

evidence.text: Which charged Nariai geometries survive in Einstein–Maxwell–dilaton theories, how do their solution spaces depend on the dilaton couplings and potential, and under what background conditions could their instantons describe black-hole pair creation?

sources.title: Pair-production of charged Dirac particles on charged Nariai and ultracold black hole manifolds

evidence.text: Compute the Euclidean determinant through the spectral zeta function of μ²−D², with W_E=½ζ′(0), then continue eE→ieE. KK factorization, heat-kernel degeneracies and Hurwitz-zeta identities are used; Nariai additionally uses Abel–Plana transformations.

sources.title: Festina Lente: EFT Constraints from Charged Black Hole Evaporation in de Sitter

evidence.text: Inspect derivative structure, introduce an auxiliary derivative, separate algebraic from differential variables, and invert the mixed system on regular intervals. Local initial-value solvability requires compatible electromagnetic data and does not imply arbitrary two-horizon boundary-value solvability.

sources.title: Catastrophic emission of charges from near-extremal Nariai black holes

evidence.text: Separate the charged Klein-Gordon equation using spherical harmonics and frequency or momentum modes; solve the resulting ordinary differential equations with Gauss hypergeometric functions.

sources.title: Charged Nariai black holes on the dark bubble

evidence.text: The bulk equations are treated using large-ku Fefferman–Graham expansions and a perturbation in k2²/k². Matching the two sides requires coordinate rescalings and choices of integration constants; the first-order constants a1 and c1 are initially undetermined by the asymptotic equations.

sources.title: Charged Nariai black holes with a dilaton

evidence.text: Use the constant dilaton to rescale the Maxwell field and cosmological term: F̃=e^(−aφ)F and Λ̃=Λe^(2bφ). The remaining dilaton equation supplies an algebraic constraint rather than a differential equation.

sources.title: Pair creation of dilaton black holes in extended inflation

evidence.text: Match inner Euclidean and outer Lorentzian approximations along a complex-time contour. Small imaginary initial scalar components are chosen so the outer solution becomes real; regularity requires α(0)=0, α̇(0)=1 and vanishing initial scalar derivatives, with finite stationary β for black holes.

sources.title: Generalized Charged Nariai Solutions in Arbitrary Even Dimensions with Multiple Magnetic Charges

evidence.text: Can even-dimensional charged Nariai geometries built from two-dimensional factors carry several magnetic charges, arise as limits of black-hole solutions, and extend to gravitational theories with higher-curvature terms?

sources.title: Curvature properties of Nariai spacetimes

evidence.text: Which local curvature identities, Einstein-type classifications, tensor compatibility conditions and recurrence structures characterize charged Nariai spacetime and a broader family of direct-product metrics?

sources.title: Tunneling method for Hawking radiation in the Nariai case

evidence.text: Can exact field solutions on charged Nariai spacetime corroborate Hamilton–Jacobi tunneling for Hawking radiation, and what probability does the usual semiclassical emission factor represent?

sources.title: Saturation of Pauli blocking in near-extremal charged Nariai black holes

evidence.text: How does spontaneous emission of massive charged spin-1/2 fermions behave as a charged Nariai black hole approaches coincident event and cosmological horizons, and does Pauli blocking prevent the catastrophic amplification reported for charged scalars?

sources.title: Black hole extremality in nonlinear electrodynamics: a lesson for weak gravity and Festina Lente bounds

evidence.text: Do nonlinear electromagnetic corrections preserve the WGC-motivated monotonicity of black-hole extremality beyond four-derivative truncation, and how do light charged particles modify Nariai spectra relevant to the Festina Lente bound?

sources.title: Uniqueness of extremal charged black holes in de Sitter

evidence.text: Does the near-horizon geometry of an extremal Reissner–Nordström–de Sitter horizon determine the surrounding analytic electrovacuum spacetime, including charged Nariai, ultracold and generic cold black holes?

sources.title: Thermal Festina Lente

evidence.text: How do thermal pair creation and conduction by existing equilibrium charge carriers modify Nariai-black-hole discharge, the Festina Lente mass bound, and its particle-physics and inflationary implications?

sources.title: Festina Lente: EFT Constraints from Charged Black Hole Evaporation in de Sitter

evidence.text: Does rapid discharge force collapse for horizon-crossing initial surfaces and configurations slightly away from exact Nariai?

sources.title: Catastrophic emission of charges from near-extremal charged Nariai black holes. II. Rotation effect

evidence.text: How does rotation affect spontaneous charged-scalar emission from near-extremal charged Nariai black holes, including catastrophic production and possible evolution toward naked singularities?

sources.title: A local rigidity theorem for minimal two-spheres in an electrovacuum spacetime

evidence.text: Can local maximization of charged Hawking mass, or saturation of an area–charge bound, force a neighborhood of a minimal two-sphere to have Reissner–Nordström–de Sitter or charged Nariai geometry?

sources.title: Pair creation of black holes during inflation

evidence.text: What instantons and semiclassical rates describe neutral and magnetically charged black-hole pair creation during inflation, how do the holes evolve, and what relic abundance follows within the adopted inflationary model?

sources.title: The fate of Reissner--Nordström--de Sitter black holes: nonequilibrium discharge and evaporation

evidence.text: How do anomaly-induced energy transport, Schwinger discharge, and electromagnetic work jointly determine RN–dS evolution, the status of classical equilibrium loci, and the endpoint of controlled rapidly discharging trajectories?

sources.title: Extremal black hole decay in de Sitter space

evidence.text: Does including higher-order backreaction in charged black hole emission modify the Festina Lente argument that unsuppressed Nariai discharge produces a big crunch for every observer?

sources.title: Large field inflation models from higher-dimensional gauge theories

evidence.text: Assuming the weak gravity conjecture and a large tensor signal, which large-field axion inflation models obtainable from higher-dimensional Abelian gauge theories have acceptable gauge couplings, compactification scales and charge assignments?

sources.title: Natural Inflation and Quantum Gravity

evidence.text: Can natural inflation with a parametrically large effective axion range be realized in a controlled higher-dimensional effective theory while satisfying the quantum-gravity constraints represented by the paper's Weak Gravity Conjecture criterion?

sources.title: Transplanckian axions!?

evidence.text: Can superplanckian axion periods support large-field inflation after including semiclassical gravitational instantons, and do single axions, lattice alignment, and diagonal multi-axion trajectories behave differently?

sources.title: Planckian Axions and the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Do the WGC and gravitational instantons exclude super-Planckian fundamental-domain diameters, and hence large-field inflation without monodromy, in theories with many axions?

sources.title: Winding out of the Swamp: Evading the Weak Gravity Conjecture with F-term Winding Inflation?

evidence.text: Can flux-induced winding of complex-structure axions support controlled transplanckian natural inflation, while avoiding proposed instanton obstructions and remaining compatible with the mild axionic weak gravity conjecture?

sources.title: On Axionic Field Ranges, Loopholes and the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Does the axionic weak gravity conjecture bound the diameter of a multi-axion cosine potential, and what would a controlled loophole using suppressed WGC instantons require?

sources.title: Large-Field Inflation with Multiple Axions and the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: How does the effective field range scale with axion number N, arbitrary alignment and number P of potential-generating instantons? If quantum gravity bounds that range, how rapidly must P grow?

sources.title: Weak Gravity Strongly Constrains Large-Field Axion Inflation

evidence.text: Which compact-axion inflation models permit parametrically super-Planckian field ranges under the Weak Gravity Conjecture, and what additional assumptions are needed to constrain alignment models that evade the ordinary WGC?

sources.title: Can Gravitational Instantons Really Constrain Axion Inflation?

evidence.text: How strongly can calculable gravitational instantons constrain large-field axion inflation, once moduli dynamics, the four-dimensional cutoff and numerical suppression factors are included?

sources.title: Large Field Inflation/Quintessence and the Refined Swampland Distance Conjecture

evidence.text: Can a leading instanton potential produce a large canonical axion range while the instanton expansion and stabilization of the remaining fields remain controlled?

sources.title: Instanton Resummation and the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: What restrictions do dense towers of superextremal instantons impose on large-field axion inflation once the full charge-lattice sum is included, and which effective theories can evade those restrictions?

sources.title: Large field inflation models from higher-dimensional gauge theories

evidence.text: Reduce five-dimensional Chern–Simons terms to axionic gauge couplings and estimate ξi=αiσ̇i/(2fiH), the parameter controlling gauge-production effects. Naturalness is assessed qualitatively using expected parameter ranges rather than a Bayesian comparison.

sources.title: Natural Inflation and Quantum Gravity

evidence.text: A magnetic-soliton argument compares the Maxwell self-energy outside a cutoff-sized core with its gravitational radius, motivating a cutoff of order gMpl. The derivation assumes elementary magnetic constituents should avoid already being black holes.

sources.title: Transplanckian axions!?

evidence.text: They diagonalize G, canonically normalize the fields, and examine integer charges in the dual lattice to identify small-action harmonics. Instanton–string linking phases supply additional charge-selection constraints.

sources.title: Planckian Axions and the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Map the dominant classical instanton to a shortest-vector problem in the charge lattice with metric K^−1. Apply Minkowski's theorem and Stirling's approximation, then use LLL lattice reduction for numerical ensemble estimates.

sources.title: Winding out of the Swamp: Evading the Weak Gravity Conjecture with F-term Winding Inflation?

evidence.text: Uses large-complex-structure expansions of the Kähler potential and period vector, together with the Gukov–Vafa–Witten flux superpotential. Selected flux components suppress unwanted polynomial dependence; geometric exponential corrections supply the eventual axion potential.

sources.title: On Axionic Field Ranges, Loopholes and the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Compare the classical actions of spectator and dominant instanton families in the same kinetic metric. Examine whether all spectator contributions along the inflationary direction, and higher-charge contributions of the dominant family, remain suppressed.

sources.title: Aligned natural inflation with modulations

evidence.text: Does aligned natural inflation compatible with the multi-axion weak gravity conjecture generically acquire subleading potential modulations, and what oscillations and observational constraints follow?

sources.title: Sharpening the Supersymmetric Axion Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Can the order-one coefficient in the axion WGC be sharpened, and can supersymmetry impose stronger instanton and axion-string bounds with consequences for multi-axion inflation?

sources.title: Some open questions in axion theory

evidence.text: Which proposed resolutions of axion quality, large-field inflation and monodromy backreaction survive quantum gravity, and what precise axion Weak Gravity Conjecture bounds are justified?
